title: Old man Joshua
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s Bible story, 
Joshua is now a very old man.
He is 110 years old!
He tells the Israelites to 
SERVE GOD ONLY!

Joshua tells them to CHOOSE who they will serve
Joshua says that he and the people living in his home will 
SERVE the LORD
Here are some ways to serve the Lord

Let us make a FRIDGE MAGNET
YOU WILL NEED CRAFT STICKS, GLUE, KOKIS and YOUR IMAGINATION

Watch teacher Faz
How to make your own fridge magnet

Talk to Jesus
Dear Lord Jesus
Thank you for the Bible
Thank you for loving me
Please help me to grow everyday
by reading the Bible and Praying to You everyday
Amen
